evidence.notes: The current client negotiates the paged namespace contract with a 0.3.2 gateway.
A 0.3.2 client reads, writes, and browses through the current gateway.
The 0.4.0 indexed client reaches the current indexed gateway contract.
The current client and gateway are exercised together.
The current client and gateway exercise durable on-demand namespace indexing together.
The current client and gateway exercise always-participating indexed search, retained administrative policy, and cancellation/deletion lifecycle behavior.
Core and paged namespace operations remain compatible; indexed-search lifecycle versions do not overlap and retired opt-in/out actions are rejected.

release_lines.name: paged
release_lines.notes: Capabilities, paged browse, browse sessions, and live search.

release_lines.name: indexed-on-demand
release_lines.notes: Adds durable on-demand index enrollment and per-server scheduling controls.

release_lines.name: indexed-always-on
release_lines.notes: Usable enrolled indexes always participate under gateway policy. Per-server opt-in/out is removed; operator cancellation defers the next automatic attempt.
